highlights.zh: 修复 Browser 与 CEP 的本地图标加载，窄尺寸下仍保持关键图标可见。
highlights.en: Fixed local icon loading across Browser and CEP, keeping key icons visible at narrow widths.

highlights.zh: 收敛 Adobe 未连接时的 WebSocket 提示，离线状态不再干扰主要操作。
highlights.en: Reduced WebSocket noise while Adobe is disconnected so offline use no longer interrupts the main workflow.

highlights.zh: 优化快捷采集面板与 Action Orbit 的响应式布局和宿主路由。
highlights.en: Improved responsive Quick Capture and Action Orbit layouts and host routing.
